about_the_game:
A Ragdoll Rage Game may look bright, goofy, and harmless at first glance—but don’t be fooled. Beneath the silly ragdoll physics and colorful style hides a brutally challenging climbing game where every move counts!

Test your patience and skill by grabbing, flinging, and stumbling your way across difficult obstacles. The controls may look simple, but mastering them is another story. One wrong move can send you tumbling all the way back down… and you’ll have to decide if you’ve got the determination to climb back up.

Features

  • Physics-based climbing - Player is completely ragdoll, but precisely controllable

  • Secret Paths - Discover hidden areas and unlock exclusive badges

  • Character Customization - Put your face on your ragdoll and change their look

  • Cosmetics - Unlock over 50+ hats just by playing

  • Level Editor - Create your very own level and share them with your friends

  • Leaderboard - Compete for the fastest times and climb the rankings

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS (64-bit) or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X with Mesa drivers
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 with Mesa drivers
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra (or later, 64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 equivalent / Apple M1 (Rosetta supported)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon R9 M290 / Intel Iris Pro 5200 (roughly GTX 750 Ti equivalent for mac)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / Apple M1 or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 560 / Apple M1 GPU (equivalent to GTX 1050 Ti / RX 560 range)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
